messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up 1 candidate Evan Ruiz visiting 2027-05-11, arrival 08:00. Important: Evan will bring a certified service dog (golden retriever). Onsite loop 10:00-15:00. Needs: service-animal relief area close to west entrance, a quiet rest spot near interviewing rooms, and a seating plan that keeps known severe-allergy panelists separated. Also asked about reimbursement for pet transport fee (airline charge).
Lina Park: Noted. We have an outdoor relief pad by West Entrance - I'll reserve the covered spot and put a temporary mat + waste bags. Also will ask cleaning to do a pre-visit wipe-down with fragrance-free products.
Facilities: We'll provide a non-slip mat, water bowl, and a small folding gate to section off a quiet nook in Conf B. I'll label the area "Service Animal Rest Zone" and add a laminated info card about handler responsibilities.
Security: Reminder: service animals are permitted in public areas but not in secure labs or server rooms. We'll draft an escorted route from lobby -> rest area -> Conf B so dog never approaches secure doors. Handler must keep dog leashed at all times.
Front Desk: We'll print an additional badge for the handler and hold an envelope "Evan Ruiz - Service Dog Info" with a short checklist (vaccination proof copy if candidate provided it), leash rules, and a map to the relief area. ID required for pickup.
Maya Singh: Two panelists (Grace + Omar) flagged severe animal allergies (cat/dander). Can we seat them in Conf C (filtered HVAC) and ensure no dog in that room? Also I'll note on the invite and ask panelists to avoid perfume that day.
Priya Menon: Yes please do that seating swap. Candidate ok with the dog staying in the rest nook; they appreciate the extra care. For pet transport fee: policy?
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: service_dog_prep, relief_area, rest_nook, cleaning_notice, seating_swap, envelope_at_front_desk. Policy pointer: "reasonable travel expenses (incl. documented pet fees) require receipts and hiring manager approval". Calendar updated and notes added to candidate doc.
Security: We'll also have a short sign-off form for the handler acknowledging routes and restricted areas (informational only, not a waiver). We'll DM the Front Desk the form for printing.
Lina Park: Who can meet Evan at the lobby? I can do it but I'm out that morning until 08:30. Maya, can you be backup at 08:15?
Maya Singh: I can be at the lobby at 08:00 to meet them and walk the escorted route. Lina will pick up any followups.
Priya Menon: Perfect. Thanks team 64f. I'll confirm reimbursement language with hiring manager and post receipts process here once approved. Any other blockers?
Facilities: None from facilities side. We'll leave the rest area setup by 07:30.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight monitor enabled if traveling. Will post arrival updates here. :paw_print:
